<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the dining hall.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we talk about?
Exercising after a meal
Drinking coffee after a meal
Getting horny after a meal
Gonta agrees!

Exercise after meals is tough...
But you no can skip it!

To help person in need, you gotta train body
every day!
Shuchi can drink coffee?
Gonta...no can drink coffee...

Too bitter for Gonta...
But...coffee is gentleman drink...
O-Okay! Gonta try hard to drink...one sip!
Huh? Gonta not see any horns.

Sorry...Gonta not always understand.
Gonta not smart boy...

But Gonta trust Shuichi...
Shuichi horns prolly invisible...

<CLT=cltMIND>Gonta is completely silent.
That's pretty rare...
(Hmmm...)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Gonta's inner thoughts...?
